"""CivicPulse: triage city 311 requests by urgency & cluster by location. stdlib only."""
import csv, io, sys, collections
URG={'gas':5,'leak':4,'fire':5,'flood':4,'pothole':2,'graffiti':1,'streetlight':3,'trash':2,'noise':1}
def score(t):
    t=t.lower(); return max([v for k,v in URG.items() if k in t] or [1])
def triage(rows):
    out=[(score(r['text']),r['zip'],r['text']) for r in rows]
    return sorted(out,reverse=True)
def hotspots(rows):
    return collections.Counter(r['zip'] for r in rows).most_common(3)
if __name__=='__main__':
    data=sys.stdin.read(); rows=list(csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(data)))
    for s,z,t in triage(rows): print(s,z,t)
    print('hotspots',hotspots(rows))

# CivicPulse
Triage 311 requests by urgency and surface zip-code hotspots so city crews dispatch the dangerous issues first.
Run: `printf 'zip,text\n95112,gas leak\n95116,pothole\n' | python3 app.py`

## Why
311 queues are first-come-first-served; dangerous reports wait behind trivial ones.

`python3 test_app.py`  Sample: `python3 app.py < sample.csv`
## Limits / next
Keyword scoring is crude; next: learned classifier, geocoding, real SJ open-data feed.
"""CivicPulse: triage city 311 requests by urgency & cluster by location. stdlib only."""
import csv, io, sys, collections
URG={'gas':5,'leak':4,'fire':5,'flood':4,'pothole':2,'graffiti':1,'streetlight':3,'trash':2,'noise':1}
def score(t):
    t=t.lower(); return max([v for k,v in URG.items() if k in t] or [1])
def triage(rows):
    out=[(score(r['text']),r['zip'],r['text']) for r in rows]
    return sorted(out,reverse=True)
def hotspots(rows):
    return collections.Counter(r['zip'] for r in rows).most_common(3)
if __name__=='__main__':
    data=sys.stdin.read(); rows=list(csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(data)))
    for s,z,t in triage(rows): print(s,z,t)
    print('hotspots',hotspots(rows))

# CivicPulse
Triage 311 requests by urgency and surface zip-code hotspots so city crews dispatch the dangerous issues first.
Run: `printf 'zip,text\n95112,gas leak\n95116,pothole\n' | python3 app.py`

## Why
311 queues are first-come-first-served; dangerous reports wait behind trivial ones.
## Test
`python3 test_app.py`  Sample: `python3 app.py < sample.csv`
## Limits / next
Keyword scoring is crude; next: learned classifier, geocoding, real SJ open-data feed.
